name: ankipaper
description: Anki client for Amazon Kindle. Lets you sign in to AnkiWeb, browse decks with statistics, and review cards through the built-in Kindle browser - no JS in notes, no colour UI, only what reads well on e-ink.
author: axio

scripts.update: git pull && docker compose down && docker compose up --build
scripts.type-check: python -m compileall app/ && mypy app/ && ruff check app/
